title: Great GASPI Data Schema
perspective: Republic of Armenia / Artsakh authorities / Armenian rights and displacement advocates

control_zones.zone_name: Former Nagorno-Karabakh Autonomous Oblast / Republic of Artsakh (pre-2023)
control_zones.governing_authority: Republic of Artsakh (pre-2023) / now under Azerbaijani control (de facto)
control_zones.access_restrictions: Following the 2023 Azerbaijani military offensive, the Republic of Artsakh capitulated on September 20, 2023. The population of approximately 120,000 ethnic Armenians fled to Armenia by the end of September 2023.
strategic_features_located_here: Lachin Corridor (critical land link to Armenia)

demographics.notes: The entire Armenian population of Nagorno-Karabakh (approximately 120,000 ethnic Armenians) fled to Armenia following the capitulation of the Republic of Artsakh on September 20, 2023. The displacement occurred over days, and by September 30, 2023, almost 120,000 people had arrived in Armenia.

named_high_ground_features.name: Shushi / Shusha Heights
named_high_ground_features.functional_strategic_description: Strategic high ground over Stepanakert and the Karabakh region; control of observation and fire control over the Lachin Corridor approaches; historically significant military position
named_high_ground_features.control_zone: Former Republic of Artsakh / now under Azerbaijani control

physical_barriers.name: Lachin Corridor
physical_barriers.temporal_variations: The corridor served as the sole life-line connecting Nagorno-Karabakh to Armenia. Following a ceasefire in November 2020, Russian peacekeepers were deployed to guard it. Azerbaijan established a blockade of the corridor from December 2022. The corridor came under Azerbaijani control following the September 2023 offensive.
physical_barriers.stated_justification: Azerbaijan justified the blockade and subsequent control citing environmental and security concerns.
physical_barriers.opposing_characterization: Armenian and international human rights organizations characterized the blockade as illegal, a humanitarian crisis, and a violation of the 2020 ceasefire agreement and international law.

water_infrastructure.name: Sarsang Reservoir
water_infrastructure.controlling_entity: Formerly under Artsakh control; now under Azerbaijani control

environmental_degradation_incidents.stated_justification: Azerbaijan justified the blockade citing environmental and security concerns.
environmental_degradation_incidents.opposing_characterization: The blockade was characterized by Armenian and international bodies as a violation of the November 2020 ceasefire agreement and international law, which contributed to a humanitarian crisis.
documenting_orgs: International Committee of the Red Cross (ICRC)

airspace_and_spectrum.flight_corridor_control: The airspace over Nagorno-Karabakh is controlled by Azerbaijan, which suspended flights from Armenia to Artsakh.
airspace_and_spectrum.stated_justification: Azerbaijan's control over its airspace and borders.

trade_and_dual_use_controls.transit_permit_regimes: Azerbaijan controls all transit through the Lachin Corridor.

checkpoints_and_gates.name: Lachin Corridor Checkpoint
checkpoints_and_gates.opposing_characterization: The checkpoint is part of the illegal blockade of the Lachin Corridor.

jurisprudence_and_statutory_friction.preferred_or_prior_system_name: Artsakh Constitution and laws / Armenian law

landmark_jurisprudence_and_treaties.holding_or_standard: The ICJ ordered that Azerbaijan 'take all measures at its disposal to ensure unimpeded movement of persons, vehicles and cargo along the Lachin Corridor in both directions.'
landmark_jurisprudence_and_treaties.official_legal_rationale: Azerbaijan stated it was unable to enforce the order due to domestic security concerns.

landmark_jurisprudence_and_treaties.case_or_resolution_name: Briefing on the situation in the Lachin Corridor
landmark_jurisprudence_and_treaties.holding_or_standard: The UN Security Council heard briefings on humanitarian concerns and the blockade, though no resolution was passed.
landmark_jurisprudence_and_treaties.official_legal_rationale: Azerbaijan disputed the nature of the crisis.

documented_statutory_conflicts.enforced_clause_reference: Azerbaijani law abolishing the Republic of Artsakh
documented_statutory_conflicts.conflict_description: A direct conflict between the abolition of the Republic of Artsakh by Azerbaijan and the international and Armenian legal positions concerning the right to self-determination of the Armenian population.

official_threat_assessments_or_attack_st.numbers_or_incidents: Disruption of food, medicine, and energy supplies

stated_administrative_or_security_ration.opposing_characterization: The blockade was a deliberate act of war and ethnic cleansing.
